page.layout: One printed page on the scan, rotated about 90 degrees. It carries only an engraved plate of figures and diagrams. No running text, heading, page number or note is printed.
page.notes: The page is an engraved plate, not text. It shows several circular and oval figures, including a pair of framed roundels on the left, a large arched or cartouche-like form with a vertical element at upper right, a seated or standing figure in an arched frame at lower right, and a pointed or tent-like object in the centre. A blue ink stamp, a library mark, is in the lower left and is not transcribed. Faint dark marks at the top centre may be a plate number or running mark, but they are too indistinct to read, so no page number is given.
